auditor_rules: Do not trust manifest status as evidence by itself.
Recompute or independently verify all available hashes.
Read referenced reports and validate required verdicts.
Recount full source scope independently when source format permits.
Check that all CLOSED_VERIFIED ranges cover source exactly once except identical verified overlaps.
Check recovery output and terminal chain hash independently.
Treat missing or unreadable evidence as BLOCK.
Do not repair findings during audit.
independence_definition: Audit must derive verdict from referenced evidence, not from the previous E-Prime checkpoint percentage.
hundred_percent_binding: Final 100% gate cannot run without PASS_PRECLOSE.
